title: Littlewell and Below: a cozy roguelike deckbuilder where you and the enemy draw from one shared deck
author: oxygenal
selftext:
I've been building this solo and would love feedback on the trailer and the idea.
    
    The hook: you and the critter you're fighting draw from the same Well (one shared deck). Every card has an owner, and you fight over who owns each one. Play their cards against them, and keep the ones you take. Win, and the critter is cured and moves into your village.

comments.author: barret232hxc
comments.body: I love stuff like this. cozy, cute, and full of personality and charm. I was trying to wishlist this bad boy haha, I guess you're just seeing what people initially think. The shared deck mechanic sounds really interesting as well. Is there anywhere to follow for updates or anything. I don't want to forget about this one

replies.author: oxygenal
replies.body: May be I will create a steam page later and let you know.  Everything was made by ai using various model but mainly coded by claude Opus.  Your comment is encouraging, thank you.

replies.author: barret232hxc
replies.body: if you don't wanna pay for the $100 for a steam page, maybe start with an itch page or something once you get a playable demo then you can get feedback, and eventually get a steam page. I see a lot of people do that. But yeah this is right up my alley.

comments.author: Maple-Syrup89
comments.body:
The strand lights in town not connecting, just floating in the air bug me, but the concept is an interesting spin on deck building. 

I have been prototyping a deck builder concept that flips some of mechanics from the standard. In my case, its 2 decks, cards for turn based movement, and cards for non movement actions. Cards also change depending on the current status of other systems.

replies.author: oxygenal
replies.body: sound interesting. thanks for feedback. let me know  when you have a demo or something
